paper_identity.title: The collective 1+ state in triaxial nuclei
paper_identity.journal: Zeitschrift für Physik A Atomic Nuclei

cross_mass_significance: Proves that non-axial triaxial deformation gamma breaks the degeneracy of the K=1 scissors mode, splitting it into two distinct 1+ collective branches vibrating about the medium and short axes with energy splitting proportional to tan(gamma), refuting the universal single-Lorentzian scissors mode parametrization in gamma-soft and triaxial nuclei.
